replication.target_description: The complete main paper and nine-page author supplement were examined. The replication used women and neutral/erotic pictures only. Supplement tests 1 and 5 compare neutral versus erotic performance; tests 2 and 6 concern erotic versus chance; tests 3 and 4 are correlations. No pooled nonerotic-picture accuracy versus chance test matching the original was located. Neutral-versus-erotic is a known test mismatch and neutral-only stimuli differ from the original pooled nonerotic stimuli.

notes: Original values belong to the pooled nonerotic one-sample t test, not to an erotic-versus-nonerotic comparison. Original p is one-tailed (p. 409, footnote 3). General author conclusion is not an effect-specific verdict for this missing test; no success category inferred. No statistics from a different comparison substituted.
